title: Plan: Explore concept of PowerShell module for SMB2 & Reg
description: Is it feasible to create a PowerShell module based on Titanis functionality that will allow for interaction with remote hosts over SMB2 and Remote Registry using backup privilege? Need functionality to connect, list, get, modify, create, delete, copy and interact with security descriptors (read/write).
design: I'm looking for feasibility first, then design ideas and concepts, then do a planning phase before breaking the project up into multiple beads issues.

title: SMB2 provider: enforce backup intent on all opens
description: Audit provider operations (enumeration, Get/Set-Content, New/Remove/Copy) and ensure all SMB2 create/open calls set OpenForBackupIntent and use backup/restore access rights.
close_reason: Implemented TBO SMB2 provider with backup intent

comments.author: JimSykora
comments.text:
If this is being added to the current Titanis.SMB2 provider the enforced backup/restore rights and flags should be gated behind a switch so as to not remove current functionality from the provider.  

If it's a net-new provider, then full backup enforcement is fine.

comments.author: Jim Sykora
comments.text: Decision: create a new provider named TBO.Smb2 based on the current provider to avoid changing existing behavior.

comments.author: Jim Sykora
comments.text: Decision: new PowerShell module name will be Titanis.TBO.Smb2 with provider default PSDrive name tbo-smb (side-by-side with existing module).

title: Backup-only session context and privilege enablement
description: Implement a shared connection/session context that enables SeBackupPrivilege and SeRestorePrivilege on the remote token after logon and enforces backup-only mode for all SMB2/MS-RRP operations.

comments.author: Jim Sykora
comments.text: Implemented backup-only session enforcement: Smb2Client.RequiredCreateOptions propagated to sessions and ORed into all create requests; TBO provider sets OpenForBackupIntent on its Smb2Client. Added ISmb2TraceCallback hook to verify SeBackupPrivilege/SeRestorePrivilege via LSARPC over the authenticated session (IPC$) and fail fast with a clear error if missing. Build ok (existing warnings).

comments.author: Jim Sykora
comments.text: Added auto-grant flow: LSARPC adds SeBackupPrivilege/SeRestorePrivilege on missing accounts (open or create LSA account with AdjustPrivileges), marks session for reauth, and Smb2Client now retries authentication once when a session requests reauth. Added InternalsVisibleTo for TBO access to Smb2Session.RequiresReauth. Build ok (existing warnings).

title: TBO SMB2 cmdlet surface (connect/options)
description: Rename or add TBO-prefixed SMB2 connection cmdlets (Connect-TBOSmbServer, Set-TBOSmbConnectOptions) and update module exports/manifest to avoid non-prefixed collisions.

comments.author: JimSykora
comments.text: This may be moot since we created a new Titanis.TBO.SMB2 provider instead of using the existing Titanis.SMB2.PowerShell provider?

title: TBO SMB2 security descriptor cmdlets
description: Implement Get-TBOSmbSecurityDescriptor/Set-TBOSmbSecurityDescriptor with portable SecurityDescriptor output, plus -AsSddl and -AsBytes options.

title: TBO SMB2 copy cmdlet
description: Implement Copy-TBOSmbItem with backup-intent opens for source/dest and optional preservation of timestamps and security descriptors.

title: TBO Remote Registry key/value cmdlets
description: Implement Get/New/Remove-TBORegKey and Get/Set/Remove-TBORegValue using MS-RRP with RegistryKeyOptions.BackupRestore on every open.

title: TBO Remote Registry security descriptor cmdlets
description: Implement Get-TBORegSecurityDescriptor/Set-TBORegSecurityDescriptor with portable SecurityDescriptor output and backup-restore registry opens.

title: Portable SecurityDescriptor helpers and adapters
description: Create shared helpers to emit SecurityDescriptor objects, SDDL strings, and raw bytes, with optional Windows-only adapters to System.Security.AccessControl types for PowerShell on Windows.

title: TBO SMB2 provider logging and file ops fixes
description: Fix TBO provider Get-Content/New-Item behaviors, simplify content reader parameters, add local SMB2 trace logging via TITANIS_TBO_LOG, and document backup-privilege assumptions.

title: Add proper build solution for Titanis.TBO.SMB2 module
